ess.caveat.ferry.day: Only the explicitly selected source day is parsed. Date-picker options are not confirmed sailing dates.
ess.caveat.ferry.operator: No fallback, extrapolated sailings, vessel names, arrivals, or live status. Confirm travel with the operator.
ess.caveat.timeUnknown: updated_at is null because the operator publication time is unknown; retrievedAt is the fetch time.
ess.caveat.flight.third: Third-party published timetable, not live operations or airline confirmation.
ess.caveat.flight.rows: Only explicit weekday rows whose published validity includes today are returned. Expired, future-only, and undated rows are excluded. No current records does not mean no flights.
ess.caveat.flight.cache: Unverified local cache files are not used. updated_at is null: the publication time is unknown.
mcp.h1.question: question.
mcp.hero: One of the tools we build with AI to bring Maio closer to everyone. Ask, research, and learn about the island in your own words.
mcp.how.lead: For people who live here, visit, or want to know more.
mcp.step1.title: Discover places.
mcp.step1.text: Want to know the island's beaches? Ask where they are and request the links to learn more.
mcp.step2.title: Understand the numbers.
mcp.step2.text: How does tourism change through the year? Explore the data and ask for a simple explanation.
mcp.step3.title: Keep discovering.
mcp.step3.text: Did an answer make you curious? Ask for more detail, compare, or ask another question.
mcp.useful.lead: You don't need technical terms. Say what you want to discover and ask for help understanding the answer.
mcp.tip1.title: Say what you're looking for.
mcp.tip1.text: Try: “I want to know Maio's beaches. Where can I find information about each one?”
mcp.tip2.title: Ask where the information comes from.
mcp.tip2.text: Ask “Where do these numbers come from?” or “Which year are they?”. Open the links to see the source.
mcp.tip3.title: Ask for a simpler explanation.
mcp.tip3.text: If something is unclear, say “Explain it more simply” or “Give me an example”. The conversation can continue.
mcp.faq.title: Frequently asked questions.
mcp.faq.1.a: It is a way to get to know the island through a conversation. You can ask questions in ChatGPT and look up public information about places, tourism, and the economy of Maio.
mcp.faq.2.a: You can ask about beaches and places, businesses, or tourism. For example: “What data is there about businesses on Maio?” Not every topic or year has information available; ask ChatGPT to confirm what it found.
mcp.faq.3.q: Do the answers use real data?
mcp.faq.3.a: The three suggested questions show prepared answers. For other questions, the assistant checks Maio's data tools. Confirm the sources and dates given. If information is missing, ask for more context.
mcp.faq.4.q: Do I need to know how to use technology?
mcp.faq.4.a: Just write a question and press Send. You don't need to program or know the terms used in the data.
mcp.faq.6.q: Is the information always up to date?
mcp.faq.6.a: It depends on who publishes the information. Ask which year or period it refers to and check the source. If you are planning a visit, also confirm access and local conditions.
